Bettina, there are two dates, depending on what the tracker needs.

- **Official handoff: November 3, 2025.** Moss's Coastal digest of Nov 2, 2025 says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Your own cutover recap from Dec 8 also calls Nov 3 the official handoff.
- **Kwame fully taking over day to day: November 22, 2025.** Your recap says you kept running Pellucid Harbor Logistics (PHL) day to day until Nov 21, to finish the terminal cutover. Kwame took over on Nov 22.

For "officially changed hands", use Nov 3, 2025. If the tracker needs the date Kwame started running it, use Nov 22, 2025.
